transcription.text: I realized I was wrong about something.
- You scared me, thought some guy
was trying to steal my girl.
- You're dizzy and not feeling well.
Whatever you say, get some rest.
- Wait here, I'll grab you some dessert.
Make a friend, let's be friends.
- Don't be shy, I'll take good care of you.
If you still want access to my shipping routes in Europe,
you better let her have that drink with me.
I promise I'll keep my hands to myself.
- Eve, listen, just apologize to Marcus
and have a drink with him.
